text: Every insert, update, and delete against an indexed column can force a page split, and enough of those and an index's physical order on disk stops matching its logical order — that mismatch is fragmentation.

sys.dm_db_index_physical_stats measures real fragmentation and page count. REBUILD drops and recreates the index, fully defragmenting but resource-heavy. REORGANIZE walks the leaf level in place, always online, but less thorough.

Reorganize in the 5-30% fragmentation range, rebuild above that, as a starting point. On Azure, a rebuild consumes the same metered CPU, IO, and log throughput your application pays for — when and which option you pick is a cost decision too.
A rebuild refreshes statistics as a side effect, but statistics go stale on their own timeline too. Next up: statistics maintenance, and why the optimizer can go wrong even with pristine indexes.
